mapper.insert: insert into oa_sign_onboard_send_request ( request_id, batch_id, operator_user_id, payload_hash, claim_token, replay_count, create_time, update_time ) values ( #{requestId}, #{batchId}, #{operatorUserId}, #{payloadHash}, #{claimToken}, 0, sysdate(), sysdate() ) on duplicate key update operation_id = last_insert_id(operation_id), replay_count = replay_count + 1, update_time = sysdate()
mapper.select: select operation_id, request_id, batch_id, operator_user_id, payload_hash, claim_token, replay_count, create_time, update_time from oa_sign_onboard_send_request where request_id = #{requestId} limit 1
